description: Defines the TVAnim object within the YAHOO.widget namespace, providing constants for fade in/out animations and methods to retrieve animation objects and validate animation types.

methods.name: getAnim(type,el,callback)
methods.description: Returns a new animation object based on the specified type ('FADE_IN' or 'FADE_OUT') for the given element and callback.

methods.name: isValid(type)
methods.description: Checks whether the provided animation type is valid.
